definitions.gloss: vinegared dish, food dressed with vinegar
definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese dishes made with vinegar-based dressing, often served cold as a refreshing side dish.

examples.japanese: {胡瓜|きゅうり}と{若布|わかめ}の{酢|す}の{物|もの}を{作|つく}りました。
examples.english: I made a cucumber and wakame vinegared dish.

examples.japanese: {酢|す}の{物|もの}は{食欲|しょくよく}を{増進|ぞうしん}させます。
{夏|なつ}は{酢|す}の{物|もの}がさっぱりして{美味|おい}しいです。
examples.english: In summer, vinegared dishes taste refreshingly light.

notes:
{酢|す}の{物|もの} refers to dishes dressed with vinegar-based seasonings.

Common types:
- {酢|す}の{物|もの} (basic vinegar dressing)
- {三杯酢|さんばいず} (soy sauce, vinegar, mirin mixture)
- {二杯酢|にはいず} (soy sauce and vinegar mixture)
- {甘酢|あまず} (sweet vinegar)
- {土佐酢|とさず} (vinegar with dashi)

Common ingredients:
- {胡瓜|きゅうり} (cucumber)
- {若布|わかめ} (wakame seaweed)
- {蛸|たこ} (octopus)
- もずく (mozuku seaweed)
- {海老|えび} (shrimp)

Characteristics:
- Light and refreshing
- Often served as a palate cleanser
- Typically cold dishes
- Common in summer meals
